title: A whole-record write of a room the kit makes reads the room under the room lock it writes under, so a metadata change waiting for that lock is not undone
notes: Python: core/mixins/room_lifecycle.py set_agent_response_policy, the room read and written under the lock; roomkit-rs SetAgentResponsePolicy, a locked change. The policy's write holds once its read of the room answered; a metadata update of the kit, which takes the room lock, is made meanwhile and waits for it; the policy's write then lands, and the update after it: the room holds both. A write computed from a room read before its lock would let the update in first and undo it. Not observed: for RK-14.3-018, every other whole-record write the kit makes; for RK-14.1-010, the rest, which store/a-room-update-writes-the-whole-record-and-keeps-the-counters-the-store-holds observes.
